newsitem.title: FRANCE: Porsche expects roadster market to triple.
newsitem.headline: Porsche expects roadster market to triple.

text.p: The marketing director of the German sportscar maker Porsche, Hans Riedel, said on Tuesday he expected the global roadster market to triple in size during the next eighteen months.

Riedel told Reuters at the Paris car show that the market for the two-seat cabriolet sportscars would grow to around 250,000 units in the next year and a half and he expected good demand for Porsche's entry into the market -- the Boxster.

The Boxster was publicly unveiled at the Paris car show, the last of three German roadsters to come on the market over the past year. Rivals Mercedes-Benz AG and BMW AG both have roadsters in the market.
